title: 専門教養特別科目（心理学入門）
subtitle: Special Subject - Specialties Education (Introduction to Psychology)
courseType: （Provided by all courses）Liberal Arts CoursesTransdisciplinary Learning
educationalGoal: Psychology is the study of how the human mind works, primarily through the use of scientific methods.This class is intended for students who do not specialize in psychology, and introduces the concept of scientific psychology, research subjects, and representative findings obtained through research to date. The purpose of this course is to provide students with knowledge and perspectives to better understand the mind, which we all possess.
advice:
In this class, we will introduce the basic concepts of psychology, research subjects, and scientific approaches to them, as well as findings from various areas of psychology.
The human mind is thought to be a difficult subject for scientific study because it is only subjectively experienced. On the other hand, it is also of interest to many people, and therefore, there is a lot of information circulating in the world that may not be valid from a scientific point of view.
In this class, we will begin with an overview of general ideas in psychology, followed by a discussion of representative findings in various fields of psychology.
Through the various topics introduced in this class, students will learn about the scientific research methods and ways of thinking about the human mind that psychology has been striving to develop, and will come to understand the human mind and behavior in a more scientifically reliable way.
Students are expected to try to understand the various findings introduced in class by relating them to various phenomena experienced in their own daily lives.
Note that the schedule and details of the topics are subject to change.
books: References and materials will be provided in class.
requiredKnowledge:
Since psychology has conducted its own research while applying various scientific studies, basic knowledge of biology and information science would be beneficial when understanding the findings of psychology.
In addition, psychology often deals with matters related to what people experience in their daily lives. The students are expected to come to class with a positive attitude and curiosity to understand the topics covered in class in relation to their own daily lives.

              Psychology is the study of how the human mind works, primarily through the use of scientific methods.This class is intended for students who do not specialize in psychology, and introduces the concept of scientific psychology, research subjects, and representative findings obtained through research to date. The purpose of this course is to provide students with knowledge and perspectives to better understand the mind, which we all possess.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              In this class, we will introduce the basic concepts of psychology, research subjects, and scientific approaches to them, as well as findings from various areas of psychology.
The human mind is thought to be a difficult subject for scientific study because it is only subjectively experienced. On the other hand, it is also of interest to many people, and therefore, there is a lot of information circulating in the world that may not be valid from a scientific point of view.
In this class, we will begin with an overview of general ideas in psychology, followed by a discussion of representative findings in various fields of psychology.
Through the various topics introduced in this class, students will learn about the scientific research methods and ways of thinking about the human mind that psychology has been striving to develop, and will come to understand the human mind and behavior in a more scientifically reliable way.
Students are expected to try to understand the various findings introduced in class by relating them to various phenomena experienced in their own daily lives.
Note that the schedule and details of the topics are subject to change.

              教科書および参考書・リザーブドブック

              References and materials will be provided in class.

              履修に必要な予備知識や技能

              Since psychology has conducted its own research while applying various scientific studies, basic knowledge of biology and information science would be beneficial when understanding the findings of psychology.
In addition, psychology often deals with matters related to what people experience in their daily lives. The students are expected to come to class with a positive attitude and curiosity to understand the topics covered in class in relation to their own daily lives.
